## Problem

Describe the problem and link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Change

Explain the smallest meaningful behavior change and any architectural tradeoff.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and results. Include screenshots for UI changes and raw data for performance claims. State anything not tested.

- [ ] Lint, formatting, type checks, and automated tests pass.
- [ ] A regression test covers the behavior being fixed.
- [ ] The production build and applicable browser tests pass.
- [ ] Errors, cancellation, resource limits, and trust boundaries were considered.
- [ ] Keyboard and mobile behavior were checked for UI changes.
- [ ] Documentation, API behavior, and changelog are updated where necessary.
- [ ] No credentials, sensitive games, fabricated metrics, or unauthorized third-party code are included.
